subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Intriguing
solution:
The correct answer is: **Boring**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Intriguing"** means something that arouses one's curiosity or interest; fascinating. (रोचक)

 
 
• **Example: **The plot of the novel was so intriguing that I couldn't put it down.
 
 
 
• **"Boring"** refers to something that is not interesting; tedious. (नीरस)
 
 
• **Example: **The lecture was so boring that many students fell asleep.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Intriguing' **is **'Boring'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Boring**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Interesting** (दिलचस्प): Arousing curiosity or interest; holding or catching the attention.

 
 
• **Example:** The documentary on wildlife was very interesting.
 
 
 
• **Gripping** (कसनेवाला): Firmly holding the attention or interest; exciting.
 
 
• **Example: **The movie was so gripping that I was on the edge of my seat the whole time.
 
 
 
• **Historical** (ऐतिहासिक): Concerning past events or the study of history.
 
 
• **Example:** We visited many historical monuments during our trip to India.
